title: ### I. SURVEY OF CRIME ### A. IPC Crime A total of 10,77,181 cognizable crimes under Indian Penal Code were reported during 1973 in India, registering an increase of 9.4 per cent over 1972. This figure also includes crimes committed by Juveniles. There was an overall increase of 63.5 per cent in crime during the decade—(1963—1973) while the increase in population during the same period was 25.1 per cent.
